description: Implementation of an audio decoder thread for Windows platform, managing input buffers, decoding audio samples, and invoking callbacks upon decoding.

classes.name: AudioDecoderThread
classes.description: A thread class responsible for decoding audio data asynchronously, managing input buffers, and invoking callbacks when audio is decoded.

methods.name: AudioDecoderThread
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decoder thread with a decoder implementation and callback, then starts the thread.

methods.name: QueueInput
methods.description: Adds an input buffer to the queue for decoding, respecting maximum processing elements.

methods.name: QueueEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals the end of input stream by queuing an empty buffer.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main thread loop that processes input buffers, decodes audio, and calls the callback with decoded data.

methods.name: TransferPendingInputTo
methods.description: Transfers all pending input buffers from the internal queue to a provided destination queue.
